brainlife.desc: Single PNG image, usually a QC or result figure written by an App. Deprecated; use generic/images or report/html.
brainlife.name: generic/image/png
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Viewing a single QC or result figure from an App run.

**Not for:** Input to analysis Apps; it holds a picture, not data.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 25 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/generic.image.png.json

identifying_risks: Figure may show subject IDs, dates or anatomy of one participant.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level derived figures without direct identifiers are Tier 2.
sharing_cautions: Check embedded labels and titles for identifiers before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 for group-level or non-human figures.
Tier 3 if it shows recognisable facial anatomy or names.

intended_use: Viewing a single QC or result figure from an App run.
not_suitable_for: Input to analysis Apps; it holds a picture, not data.
